==English==

===Etymology===
* As a {{der|en|de|-}} surname, variant of {{m|en|Fürst}}, {{m|en|Furst}}.
* As a Jewish surname, from {{der|en|yi|פֿירשט|t=prince}}, a rendition of the above.
* As a {{der|en|sh|-}} and {{der|en|sl|-}}, from the noun {{m|sl|firšt|t=prince}}, a loanword from German and thus related to the above.
